name: Warspire
summary:
Warspire is an online auto battler for up to eight players. Each player recruits fantasy units from a shared shop, places them on an 8x4 board and fields them against one opponent at a time in rounds that resolve automatically. Losing a round costs health, and the last player standing wins the match.

Between fights, players spend gold on units and experience, manage a bench of reserves, and combine three copies of a unit to raise its star rank. Units belong to alliances that grant bonuses when enough members are on the board. Item rounds offer a choice of equipment, and each player leads a commander whose talents unlock on set rounds. Interest on saved gold and win or loss streaks shape the economy. Matches take place across five arenas: Courtyard, Glade, Dunes, Frost and Crypt. Eliminated players can stay and spectate the remaining boards.
